metadataRaw.title: Neck & Shoulder Pain? Release These 2 Muscles for INSTANT Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over the two main muscles that commonly cause neck and shoulder pain: the upper trapezius and levator scapulae.

Poor posture and inactivity can cause these muscles to become tight, weak, and strained over time, leading to neck stiffness, shoulder tension, and painful muscle knots.

To help fix this, we’ll go over easy exercises designed to stretch, release, and strengthen these key muscles for both quick and long-lasting neck and shoulder pain relief.

Each exercise works differently, so go through them all and continue using the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and start relieving neck and shoulder pain from the comfort of your home!
